written_before: any shuffled-order run of any method
shuffle: analysis/causalarena_methods.py --shuffle-seed 20261010: per-file permutation default_rng(20261010 + crc32(file name)); the graph is mapped back before scoring

Q4c.text: |F1 released - F1 shuffled| <= 0.02 for every data-driven method (supported) / > 0.05 for any (refuted)
Q4c.metric: family mean directed F1 (replicate-averaged per scenario, then averaged over scenarios) under the random rule (undecided pairs oriented at random, per-file seed): order-free for every method; lingam and notears output DAGs, so the rule does not apply to them
Q4c.secondary_reported_not_judged: the same difference under the authors' rule 'lower' (earlier column in the order the method saw -> later), which reads the released order

REP-07: each method's released-order row vs the published semantic obs-only row under the authors' rule, tolerance 3 SE of a 50-of-100 scenario mean (finite-population corrected); a failed file is scored as an empty graph and the count is reported
